limitations: Release dates come from the public embed page of each release's first track (Spotify's release date for that album); the discography grid itself only shows years, and all years agree. EPs (Spotify label "EP", 4 releases) are mapped to type "single", matching Spotify's own album_type; the original label is kept in spotifyLabel. Appears-on: only the first page of https://open.spotify.com/artist/47mIJdHORyRerp4os813jD/appears-on (44 releases) could be rendered; the page loads more on scroll, so further appears-on releases (mostly third-party compilations) may be missing. Of those 44, 26 "Various Artists" third-party compilations that only repackage Enemy were left out; the 18 artist releases (K/DA, True Damage, Imagine Dragons, Arcane soundtrack singles, Riot Forge, etc.) are kept, listing only the tracks that credit League of Legends (see tracksNote/totalTracks). Play counts are only available for the 5 "Popular" tracks on the artist page (as displayed on 2026-10-13); per-track play counts, ISRCs, labels/copyright lines, popularity scores and audio features were not retrieved (they need the authenticated Web API). Release lists are Spotify-region dependent (scraped from a US-like region); region-locked releases may be missing. No audio was fetched (Spotify is DRM-protected); embed pages expose 30s preview URLs, which were deliberately not stored or downloaded.
